name: Grin and Bear It
body:
You’re able to take on a bit more than others due to some hidden stamina.

Prerequisite(s): Grit, Inspiration, Mettle or Panache pool.

Benefit(s): You gain a bonus to one kind of saving throw (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) chosen when you gain this feat equal to 1/2 your grit, inspiration, or panache pool’s daily starting value. If you have multiple such pools, use the largest to determine the bonus granted by this feat.
